connections.name: mysql
connections.reference: Disposable MySQL for the end-to-end run. Seeded from seed/mysql.sql.

connections.name: postgres
connections.reference: Disposable PostgreSQL for the end-to-end run. Seeded from seed/postgres.sql.

connections.name: clickhouse
connections.reference: Disposable ClickHouse for the end-to-end run. Seeded from seed/clickhouse.sql.

connections.name: lake
connections.reference: MinIO standing in for an S3-compatible store. Browsing only; querying objects needs DuckDB.

connections.name: bus
connections.reference: Disposable Redpanda for the end-to-end run. One topic per compression codec.

connections.name: bus-sampled
connections.reference: The same Redpanda, read with a deliberately small budget, to show a query reads a bounded window.

connections.name: vaulted
connections.reference: The same MySQL, but its password has to come from the encrypted vault.

connections.name: risingwave
connections.reference: RisingWave over the PostgreSQL wire protocol. Only reachable under the risingwave compose profile.

connections.name: es
connections.reference: Disposable Elasticsearch for the end-to-end run. Security is off; no secret source.

connections.name: es-events
connections.reference: The same cluster, scoped to one index, so a Query DSL body needs no path.
